decisions.reason: Troubleshooting guidance during the KDP upload process does not change the required keyword content, document delivery format, or copy-and-paste use of the listing metadata.
The upload troubleshooting commitment does not change the paperback cover artifact, content, dimensions, format, or editorial-review requirements.
Guidance when the client becomes stuck during KDP upload does not alter the required back matter or author copy.
The source decision adds upload-process troubleshooting assistance but does not change the interior layout, paperback format, or trim size.
The KDP upload troubleshooting commitment does not modify the manuscript editing goal or any approved manuscript passage.
